title: Merkle enters the Flowable directory as a 16,000-staff agency group, excluded on scale and geography
content:
Merkle appears in the Flowable Partner Finder with 16,000 staff, a Columbia, Maryland base outside the EU, and the descriptor "agency group". Its row name carries its ownership: it sits inside dentsu.

The agency descriptor is part of the exclusion rather than colour. An agency group buys and builds around marketing and customer-experience outcomes, which is a different purchasing motion from a systems integrator selling delivery capacity against a client's back-office processes. Combined with the scale and the location, that leaves no version of this brief's motion that reaches it.

Nothing further was gathered, and nothing needed to be: the row was mined from the vendor's partner page on 2026-08-18 without an imprint sweep, and the exclusion applies on the card's face.
